mqtt.privateHelp: Sends mesh data to your own MQTT broker.
mqtt.outgoingWarning: Messages are sent unencrypted: use a broker you trust.

ha.title: Home Assistant MQTT Discovery
ha.help: Your radio, repeaters and contacts show up in Home Assistant on their own.
ha.gpsHelp: Each contact you pick shows on the Home Assistant map.
ha.telemetryHelp: Each repeater you pick becomes a device with its sensors. Only repeaters tracked for telemetry are listed.
ha.noTrackedRepeaters: No tracked repeaters. Turn on telemetry tracking from a repeater’s dashboard.
ha.trackedNotFound: The tracked repeaters are not in your contacts.
ha.messageEventsHelp: The messages you pick fire an event in Home Assistant for your automations.

community.help: Advanced settings for a meshcoretomqtt-compatible community collector.
community.ownerEmailHelp: Lets the collector link the node to you.

meshrank.help: Paste the topic MeshRank gave you; the rest is pre-filled.
meshrank.topicHelp: The full topic from your MeshRank setup.

letsmesh.help: Only your e-mail and region code are needed; the rest is pre-filled.

map.help: Puts the repeaters and room servers you hear on <map>map.meshcore.io</map>. This Meshloom must hold the radio's private key: firmware that allows key export, and no radio proxy in between.
map.dryRunStatusOn: Dry run on: nothing is sent, it only goes to the log.
map.geofenceHelp: Only uploads nodes near your radio.
map.noCoords: Your radio has no position: set it in Settings → Radio → Location.

scope.title: Message Scope
scope.emptyWarning: Nothing is selected: this integration will send nothing.
scope.onlyHint: New channels and contacts will not be included.
scope.exceptHint: New channels and contacts will be included.

apprise.help: Sends a notification through <apprise>Apprise</apprise> for each message: Discord, Telegram, e-mail and <services>many more</services>.
apprise.preserveIdentityHelp: Keeps the Discord webhook’s own name and avatar.
apprise.includeOutgoingHelp: Also includes messages sent from Meshloom.
apprise.markdownHelp: Turn off if Telegram rejects some sender names.
apprise.varHopsBackticked: Hops wrapped in backticks for markdown
apprise.varsFooter: Left empty, the default format applies.

webhook.help: Sends each message as JSON to a web address.
webhook.hmacHelp: With a secret, each request is signed (HMAC-SHA256).

sqs.help: Sends messages to an Amazon SQS queue.
sqs.warning: Messages are sent unencrypted: restrict access to the queue.
sqs.endpointHelp: Useful for LocalStack or custom endpoints
sqs.staticCredsHelp: Leave empty to use the server’s AWS credentials.
